title: Group of Bobbed-Hair Young Women Outdoors, 1920s Group Snapshot Photo
description: A charming 1920s snapshot capturing a large group of fourteen young women sitting closely together on a grassy lawn. Typical of the 'Roaring Twenties' and the emergence of the modern woman, nearly all of the subjects sport stylish bobbed hairstyles and period daywear, including middy blouses with sailor collars, drop-waist dresses, Peter Pan collars, and plaid fabrics. Trees and foliage form the soft-focus backdrop, suggesting a school trip, sorority retreat, or summer camp outing. The relaxed expressions and informal posing reflect youthful camaraderie and changing social freedoms for women during the post-WWI era.
